Context from Jack Heart (2026-11-16), while reducing Etude in EXP-69: "I've talked about things like having the always-on server for the report server, which I understand is different than the controller server. I would say that's in the category of things that are definitely something we're going to be building towards. It's probably not the right version of it." The existing controller server (launch/server.py: launcher database and scheduler on another host, CLI forwarding over SSH) was kept for now. When this Task is designed, decide whether one always-on server owns both the scheduler and the live report view, replacing launch/server.py rather than adding a second server.
